what: Eight photo cells each stand in a slot along a big arc, slanted at increasing angles (8°→56°). Every 3 seconds all of them move one slot forward over 1.2s ease. The first and last slots are transparent, so the cell leaving at the end is not seen and returns to the front slot and reappears, and the band flows endlessly. Slots are set by the using side’s css --fx-slot-x, --fx-slot-y and --fx-slot-r, so any curve works

options.interval: Interval to move to the next spot (s), default 3
options.delay: Wait (s) before the first move, default 0 — to start after the loader lifts, use that long
options.fade: “none” shows the first and last slots too (transparent by default)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Slots — three or more. Which slot takes which position is set by CSS :nth-child --fx-slot-x · --fx-slot-y · --fx-slot-r

from.where: index.html Hero photo strip (original .l-main-img__slider — @keyframes mv_pc_1~8 24s infinite, eight slots cycling with a 5% shift · 7.5% hold, and 92.5~0% is a transparent reset)

note: Similar: arc-wheel-cards (stands cards in a fan on a wheel at the bottom of the screen and drags them, even supports dot buttons). This part can be placed anywhere with css and only flows on its own. It stops when the panel is off screen.
